thread:
Elena: Quick sync  planning the product launch newsletter for next month. We want a segment that includes active API users + engaged newsletter subs but excludes enterprise accounts on private installs. Thoughts on subject lines?
Priya: Can we highlight the new autoscaling and cost controls? Subjects:
- "Autoscale + Cost Controls: ship LLM features with SLAs"
- "New: predictable throughput for production inference"
- "Launch: dedicated capacity & cost controls for inference"
I like the second.
Ana: Preheader candidate: "Docs, quickstart, and what to expect for Dedicated". Also recommend a top-of-email TL;DR and an anchor CTA to "Get started" and "Contact sales".
Sam: Segment rules: include users with api_calls in last 30 days OR email_open in last 30 days, exclude accounts where account_type = 'enterprise_private_install' OR tags include 'onprem'. SQL snippet:
```sql
SELECT user_id
FROM users
WHERE (api_calls >= 1 AND last_api_call >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
   OR (last_email_open >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
AND account_type != 'enterprise_private_install'
AND NOT (tags @> ARRAY['onprem']);
```
Marisol: Creative asks: hero image of console, one chart showing latency distribution, and a short customer quote (legal approved). Also add a resource link to Dedicated pricing.
Elena: Send window: Tue 10am PT. Prep for a follow-up send to non-openers after 5 days with an alternate subject.
Priya: For non-openers variant subject: "Missed this: predictable LLM throughput for production apps". Also set a suppression for customers already on Dedicated trial.
Ana: Need signoff on copy by EOD Thursday. Sam will run a quick spam test after draft is in.
Marisol: :thumbsup: will deliver copy tomorrow.
